serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Atlas, Athenium's global weather and climate data product, was originally built for the U.S. Intelligence Community in collaboration with In-Q-Tel. DHS and intelligence community programs use it for atmospheric conditions, target-area microclimate, and historical weather context anywhere in the world. Through its API, users can query seventy years of cleaned, quality-controlled data spanning 200+ variables and 2.6 million global grid cells directly from a notebook, model, or data warehouse, with results returned as columnar, model-ready data on a single coherent grid. The same data is also reachable by AI agents through a single MCP endpoint that carries the governance and provenance of the API, backed by a company that has served government stakeholders for over 12 years.
